curriculum.lesson_evidence: Water use in Australia can be studied with published statistics (urban, agricultural, industrial) and maps of major catchments. First Nations Peoples have long-standing relationships with waterways; describe these only from published Community or education sources, naming Country only when the source does. Do not invent Dreaming stories or sacred water knowledge.
curriculum.scope_limit: Proposed Stage 4 NESA HSIE alignment using catalogue outcome code GE4-1; content-point mapping remains pending. Local First Nations protocols and Community verification remain pending human review. Do not invent Country names, Dreaming stories, sacred knowledge or unverified cultural claims.

lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
List two published water-use facts for Australia and one respectful research rule for First Nations water knowledge.

FEEDBACK
Strong answer: Facts cited; rule = use approved/published sources, credit Community, do not invent sacred meanings.

WATCH FOR
Inventing a Dreaming story to 'make water cultural'. Culture belongs to Communities; use published guidance.
